mods.name: Gate Cue
mods.author: To778899
mods.summary: GATE CUE also on a playing deck: a cue plays while its pad is held, then the deck returns to it, paused.
mods.description: On the GATE CUE pad page (press HOT CUE twice) the XDJ-AZ gates only a paused deck. With this mod, pressing a set cue on a playing deck first pauses it (one PLAY press sent on the pad bus), then lets the pad through: the cue plays while held and the deck returns to it, paused, on release. Edits pad-bus input (PLAY and pad bits, that gesture only); reads the pad LEDs. Leaves the HOT CUE page, empty pads, a paused deck, two pads at once and the 4-deck view native. No audio, hooks, files or network. A Mod Menu row turns it off.
